_comment: CORS for the R2 dev bucket (PLAN 0.5). Browsers upload photos straight to R2 with presigned PUT URLs and view them with presigned GETs; without these rules the browser blocks both. Origins: the local web app, and the phone tunnels from `poe phone` (cloudflared quick tunnels are https://<random>.trycloudflare.com). Paste into the dashboard (bucket → Settings → CORS Policy); check with `uv run poe r2-cors`.
